title: Smoky Italian Chicken Skewers with Dates
description: Tender chicken skewers marinated in smoky Italian flavors and grilled to perfection, served with caramelized dates on the side.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoky Italian dressing, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread chicken pieces and dates onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot with caramelized dates on the side.
To caramelize the dates, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the dates and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
Serve the dates alongside the skewers.
